fields.subject: FW: HUSD Ransomware Incident – Final Clearance and EOC Closure – Case ID: CISA-2026-0815-001
fields.note: This is the final clearance from CISA and Veridian. All systems are restored and verified. The HUSD-CIRP-2026 has been executed per Section 11. The 05:00 roster is confirmed as accurate. Full after-action review to begin within 30 days.
